CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION by PASSWORD ='XYZ_ABC256'

-- CREDENTIAL -- 
create DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL adlssynapse1
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

--- CREATE EXTERNAL DATA Source --
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE ext_11
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'https://databdataftrial.dfs.core.windows.net/synapse',
    CREDENTIAL = adlssynapse1
)

-- Using OPENROWSET Function --

SELECT *
FROM 
OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'Revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'ext_11',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
)as query1 

-- External File Format -- 
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT csv_format 
with(
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS (
        FIELD_TERMINATOR =','
    )
)

-- Create External Table --
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE external_tbl1(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Units_Sold VARCHAR(4000),
    Revenue VARCHAR(4000)
)
with(
    LOCATION = 'Revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = ext_11,
    FILE_FORMAT = csv_format
)

SELECT * FROM external_tbl1;
